## Features

AVENIQ UI/UX design packages deliver comprehensive end-to-end product design deliverables:

- **User Research & Journey Mapping**: Identifying target user personas, mapping user pain points, and establishing clear user task flows.
- **Information Architecture & Wireframing**: Structuring site navigation blueprints, low-fidelity layout wireframes, and page hierarchy models.
- **High-Fidelity UI Interface Design**: Crafting visually engaging, modern screen interfaces in Figma equipped with custom iconography and imagery.
- **Interactive Clickable Prototyping**: Building realistic interactive prototypes for stakeholder review, investor demos, and user testing sessions.
- **Design System & Token Creation**: Engineering scalable design component libraries—including color palettes, typography scales, spacing tokens, and UI states.
- **Developer-Ready Handoff Documentation**: Preparing annotated specs, component state variations, and exported assets ready for React/Tailwind frontend integration.
- **Usability Testing & Feedback Synthesis**: Conducting structured testing sessions with real users to identify and resolve usability friction points.
